responsibility: Collects the S/390 operand and pattern predicates used by machine descriptions, from basic constant and address-shape tests through specialized predicates for LARL operands, execute patterns, multiple-register memory operations, shift counts, vector permutation constants, and symbol-sensitive memory forms. These predicates are part of the backend’s recog interface and encode target legality checks that distinguish valid RTL operands and subpatterns beyond what plain constraints can express.
